events.title: Halloween Update
events.summary: Dungeonbound 0.1.46: Halloween Update Halloween New hero: Pumpkin Head, with his own dungeon, The Hollow Patch, and the Butcher as a second Halloween hero. A new Haunted item type with over 50 haunted items built around Terror, plus Halloween quests and a relic. Haunted items drop for every hero in the roguelike modes until November 9. New Co-op for strangers: set your lobby to Open, browse open lobbies with Find Lobby, chat with your team (Show Chat), and kick players from your lobby as host. 3

events.title: We Hit 20,000 Wishlists! I cant believe it!
events.summary: I can't believe we have just hit 20k wishlists, thank you so much for everyone who has played and given me feedback so far, lots more to come, some balance fixes and updates tomorrow for bugs + A new Halloween update with some new content (characters and items)Full release in November 16th!

events.title: We Hit 15,000 Wishlists! Thank You SO SO SO MUCH!
events.summary: I'm making this solo, so seeing that number is kind of mind-blowing. Thank you to everyone who's wishlisted it, it really does make a huge difference.The demo is in Steam Next Fest, which runs today through October 26. Come give it a go! Full release in November 16th!

events.title: Bug Fix Update 0.1.22: Item Crash Fixed
events.summary: Crash fixFixed the game crashing when you dropped an item onto another item, to swap it, move it or merge it into a higher level. Thank you to everyone who sent a bug report. Other fixesSkipping a fusion forge, upgrade altar or curse shrine no longer leaves CONTINUE greyed out for the rest of the run. The gamble wheel no longer leaves a dead SPIN button behind in a later shop. HP no longer stays above Max HP after a battle that granted Max HP. ChangesTimed items now also speed up with your Speed

events.title: Dungeonbound Item Update v0.1.18
events.summary: Dungeonbound v0.1.18 Patch notes:Items- New item look- Value pills with icons on every piece. A piece with no trigger shows its strongest stats. Ammo, charges, mana and durability now sit as dots on the piece.- New mechanic: timed items. They fire on their own clock (every few seconds) instead of the trigger sweep. Charge speeds them up, Slow and Stun hold them back. A green line rises through the piece as it charges.- Six timed items: Metronome Pendant, Hourglass Band, Pendulum Mace, Tidewatch
